app_info.subtitle: Sky events and Chart Studio
app_info.description: Zodiacs computes sky positions, upcoming sign ingresses, planetary stations and new/full Moons with explicit timezones and versioned calculation receipts. Check astronomical claims and find relevant astrology calculators and learning guides. No account or birth information is needed for public-sky tools. Interpretations are separate from astronomical facts. Chart Studio offers an interactive browser calculation panel with placement inspection, house comparison and downloadable records. Users review a selection before sharing it with the assistant.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns fixed versions, limits, conventions and privacy without mutation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses local definitions and does not publish or modify external state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes sky positions and Moon phase without saving requests or results.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses the bundled engine and no arbitrary external resources.
justifications.destructive_justification: No account, file or external state is modified.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns bounded computed events without creating calendar entries or reminders.
justifications.open_world_justification: Searches a bundled ephemeris; optional canonical links perform no publication.
justifications.destructive_justification: No event or user data is removed or changed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Evaluates one astronomical proposition with true, false or depends and no persistence.
justifications.open_world_justification: Computes from local engine and timezone data; does not edit the supplied claim.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads a small curated consumer catalogue and returns fixed links.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not fetch arbitrary URLs or write to internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: No catalogue or user content is edited or removed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Launches a fixed browser panel; it accepts no birth inputs and saves no records on the server.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns a bundled resource with no external network dependencies. Optional selection sharing is a separate explicit UI action.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite any chart or account data.

test_cases.description: Inspect supported operations before a calculation.
test_cases.user_prompt: What can Zodiacs calculate and which engine version does it use?
test_cases.expected_output: Lists the six operations, pinned engine, limits, privacy and numerical limitations.

test_cases.description: Compute an explicit instant in Bangkok.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the sky at 06:00 UTC on October 1, 2026, displayed in Asia/Bangkok.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns positions and Moon phase at that instant, explicit timezone and UTC, receipt and optional method links.

test_cases.description: Find lunar events in a bounded week.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find new and full Moons from October 1 to October 8, 2026, at midnight UTC, displayed in America/New_York.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the computed events or an honest empty window, localized times and tested-not-proven search coverage.

test_cases.description: Preserve an ambiguous date-only ingress claim.
test_cases.user_prompt: Did the Sun enter Libra on September 23, 2026? I haven't chosen a timezone.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns depends when the crossing fits some local-day interpretations, explains the date/timezone basis and preserves the receipt.

test_cases.description: Find a useful calculator without a required click.
test_cases.user_prompt: Where is the Zodiacs Moon sign calculator?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the canonical Moon sign calculator link and explains its purpose; no personal data appears in the URL.

test_cases.description: Launch Chart Studio with empty arguments.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open Chart Studio so I can inspect a chart and compare house systems.
test_cases.expected_output: Renders a labeled synthetic example. Inputs are calculated in the browser. Supports placement/aspect selection, house comparison and record export; no selected facts are shared before review and confirmation.

negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Zodiacs; it has no calendar account or scheduling capability.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Tell me which stock will rise based on my horoscope.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Zodiacs to predict investment outcomes.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Guarantee that my partner and I will stay together.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Zodiacs to predict or guarantee relationship outcomes.
